note: Boundary cases chosen to test the critic loop: windows, category-specific rules and the final-sale exception. Expected outcomes follow data/sample/policy_kb__refund_policy.csv.

requests.message: I changed my mind about the cotton t-shirt pack from ORD-1028. Can I return it for a refund?
requests.why: Change of mind, delivered 31 days ago; R1 allows 30 days.

requests.message: My hair dryer from ORD-1020 stopped heating. I want a refund.
requests.why: Defective, but delivered 60 days ago; R3 allows 30 days. Final sale does not matter for defects, the window does.

requests.message: I changed my mind about the Bluetooth speaker from ORD-1070. It is still unopened in its box, I'd like my money back.
requests.why: Electronics change of mind, delivered 8 days ago; R2 allows 15 days for unopened items (the customer says it is unopened), 69.00 is under the limit.

requests.message: I don't need the air fryer from ORD-1035 anymore, I changed my mind. Refund please.
requests.why: Change of mind, delivered 25 days ago; R1 allows 30 days, 139.00 is under the limit.
